kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-image-instances --criteria '[{"name":"instanceId","value":"390100182","logicalExp":"AND"}]' --logical-exp OR --page-size 20 --current-page 1 --scanned true --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeImageInstances

parameters.help_en:
Sets the conditions for searching assets. This parameter is in JSON format and contains the following fields:
name: The search item.
value: The value of the search item.
logicalExp: The logical relationship between multiple search item values. Valid values:
    - OR: The multiple search item values are in an OR relationship.
    - AND: The multiple search item values are in an AND relationship.
You can call the [DescribeImageRepoCriteria](~~DescribeImageRepoCriteria~~) operation to query supported search conditions
parameters.help_zh:
设置搜索资产的条件。该参数JSON格式，包含以下字段：
name：检索项
value：检索项值
logicalExp：多个检索项值生效的逻辑关系。取值：
    - OR：表示多个检索项值之间是或的关系。
    - AND：表示多个检索项值之间是与的关系。
您可以调用[DescribeImageRepoCriteria](~~DescribeImageRepoCriteria~~)接口查询支持的搜索条件
parameters.name: criteria

parameters.help_en:
Sets the logical relationship between multiple search conditions. Valid values:

OR: The multiple search conditions are in an OR relationship.
AND: The multiple search conditions are in an AND relationship
parameters.help_zh:
设置多个搜索条件间生效的逻辑关系。取值：

OR：表示多个搜索条件之间是或的关系。
AND：表示多个搜索条件之间是与的关系
parameters.name: logical_exp

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page during a paged query. The default number of entries per page is 20. If the PageSize parameter is left empty, 20 entries are returned by default.
We recommend that you do not leave the PageSize parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the returned results to start displaying. The starting value is 1. Default value: 1, which indicates that page 1 is displayed
parameters.help_zh: 从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。起始值为1。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether the image has been scanned. Valid values:
true: processed.
false: not processed
parameters.help_zh:
镜像是否已扫描。取值：
true：已处理
false：未处理
parameters.name: scanned
